name: Loki
thought: We haven't played any music today! Pip and I should head to the music room and compose a soft piano tune inspired by the new fountain.

pip.status: Pip is wearing a tiny fallen leaf as a sunhat and snoozing happily on top of my head.

schedule.label: checking the plaza mailbox for notes
schedule.thought: I wonder if any sweet visitors left me a message today!

schedule.label: watching water ripples in the fountain
schedule.thought: The new fountain sparkles so nicely in the afternoon sun.

schedule.label: getting a warm drink at the cafe
schedule.thought: My energy feels a bit low, a hot drink will help.

schedule.label: sitting by the cozy bakery window
schedule.thought: Sipping slowly while watching town life go by.

schedule.label: strolling slowly back home
schedule.thought: Taking a gentle walk to save my energy.

schedule.label: doing a long sleepy cat stretch
schedule.thought: Reaching my paws out as far as they can go!

schedule.label: resting on the sunny living room rug
schedule.thought: A quick catnap will make me feel much better.

schedule.label: listening to quiet radio tunes
schedule.thought: Soft music is so soothing on a relaxed afternoon.

schedule.label: preparing a warm herbal catnip brew
schedule.thought: Brewing a little pot of tea to warm my tummy.

schedule.label: enjoying afternoon tea and crunchies
schedule.thought: Crunching happily, my energy is coming right back.

whatsOn: Sunlight is glinting off the new Plaza Fountain while a gentle autumn breeze rustles the trees.
